test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 02
subject: general
question: Eight people A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H live in an eight-storey building, one on each floor but not necessarily in the same order. The ground floor is numbered 1, the floor above it is numbered 2 and so on. Only two people live below the floor on which G lives. Only one person lives between G and A. H lives on an odd-numbered floor, but not on floor number 7. Only two people live between H and B. B does not live on the topmost floor. A does not live on the lowest floor. D lives immediately below C. Neither D nor E lives on floor number 6. Who lives immediately above A?

options.text: The one who lives on the second floor
The one who lives on the sixth floor

solution:
Eight people A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H live in an eight-storey building,

1. Only two people live below the floor on which G lives.

2. Only one person lives between G and A.

3. A does not live on the lowest floor. 

4. H lives on an odd-numbered floor, but not on floor number 7. 

5. Only two people live between H and B. B does not live on the topmost floor.

6. D lives immediately below C. Neither D nor E lives on floor number 6.

 
 

 C
